* '''Original''' ([[Puck]]): PC card image of 27 September 2019<ref name="ht-pu-0">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/0f2c3fe/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Light/large/puck.gif puck.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/0f2c3fe 0f2c3fe] (27 September 2019).</ref>, no errata mark. The pilot icon “2.” opens the game text, before the destiny sentence. Text: “[Pilot] 2. When choosing the destiny value of this card, must use 3 Force to choose 7. May deploy as a 'react.' Your Rebel pilots aboard snub fighters here are forfeit +1.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Puck (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)<ref name="sheetP-20221212">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-P.pdf Virtual Set P release sheet (updated December 2022)] (PDF, 2 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, Updated December 2022”; file created 12 December 2022). Released with [[Virtual Set P]] (24 February 2017 and 30 August 2019); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 2, file created 12 December 2022: “When choosing the destiny value of this card, must use 3 Force to choose 7. [Pilot] 2. May deploy as a 'react.' Your Rebel pilots aboard snub fighters here are forfeit +1.” '''What changed:''' Changed words: the slip is the first publication of the wording of the card image [[Puck (Errata 2)]] (PC-E2), which the PC published after the sheet. Game text: “[Pilot] 2.” was dropped; “[Pilot] 2.” was added. The sheet PDF was created at 08:37 UTC on 12 December 2022, before the card image [[Puck (Errata 2)]] was uploaded (22:10 UTC, 3 January 2023). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Puck (Errata 2)]] (published 3 January 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Puck”, pixel for pixel the same except that the picture area is left blank (white), so the slip can be laid over the picture of the card named in its lower-left corner ([[Rebel Pilot]]). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).
* '''PC-E2''' (this page): PC card image of 3 January 2023<ref name="ht-pu-1">PC card image in the PC's Holotable image set: [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/11d5d80/Images-HT/starwars/VirtualPremium-Light/large/puck.gif puck.gif], commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/11d5d80 11d5d80] (3 January 2023).</ref>, no errata mark. What changed from the previous image: re-rendered by the PC in its current card style (new frame and text font); the destiny sentence now comes first and the pilot icon “2.” moves after it; a small “71” is added beside the Premium icon. Text: “When choosing the destiny value of this card, must use 3 Force to choose 7. [Pilot] 2. May deploy as a 'react.' Your Rebel pilots aboard snub fighters here are forfeit +1.”
What changed on the card image (crops of the two published images, unchanged pixels):
